resources.string: Connect to a server that shares its commands and tools.
Nothing here yet. Refresh after adding tools on the server.
Some tools could not be loaded. Your last list is kept.
The change could not be confirmed. Refresh to see what the server kept.
The server or project changed. Open this page again before acting.
The server may have received this. Check the conversation before trying again.
Finish or clear the pending revert before adding a skill.
This server cannot do that from the app.
Saved. Refresh the model list to check availability.
Sign-in recovery could not be saved. Keep this page open and retry saving.
Finish signing in on the server or in the browser.
This sign-in ended. Forget it to start again.
A reference gives the agent access to this folder when you send your message.
Passed to the command when it runs. Leave empty to use its defaults.
Adds these instructions to this conversation. Run agent now also asks the agent to continue.
The server runs its own sign-in. Only start it if you trust this server.
Stored accounts are removed. Accounts configured in the server environment remain.
Only account names are shown here. Keys and tokens stay on the server.
This stops this phone tracking the attempt. It does not cancel anything on the server.
You will leave the app. Check the destination host before continuing.
Added for this project until the server restarts. Existing names are never overwritten.
Remove this MCP server until restart?
The running connection is removed. The server configuration remains and may restore it on restart.
Sign in on the server to make these tools available.
Enter a value for every required field.
Signed in · models are not available yet
For an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that is not in this list, such as your own model server. Its key is added next, on its row, and is never written into the settings file.
Shown before each model, like my-server/llama-3. Lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
The base address of an OpenAI-compatible API, usually ending in /v1.
Exactly as the endpoint names them.
Use one line of at most 80 characters.
Start with a letter or digit, then use lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, at most 64 in all.
This server already has a provider with this ID. Choose another one.
Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://, with no spaces.
Leave the user name and password out of the address. The key is added next, on the provider’s row.
Add at least one model ID.
Model IDs can’t contain spaces or #. Put one ID on each line.
Only on this phone’s own OpenCode
This server keeps its own settings, and the app has no way to change them. Add the provider in that server’s settings on the computer it runs on, and it shows in this list.
OpenCode on this phone has loaded it. Add its key next. If the endpoint needs no key, type any word.
OpenCode on this phone has not loaded it yet. Restarting OpenCode loads it. A reply that is running stops.
%1$s is saved, but OpenCode did not restart
Try again, or start OpenCode from This phone. The provider loads when OpenCode starts.
OpenCode restarted but does not list it yet. Try restarting it again.
OpenCode did not answer, so the app could not check that this ID is free. Try again when OpenCode is running.
OpenCode on this phone is not set up yet. Finish setup on This phone, then try again.
OpenCode’s settings file on this phone has edits the app can’t read safely, such as comments.
OpenCode on this phone also has a hand-kept settings file. The app leaves hand-kept settings alone.
OpenCode’s settings folder on this phone has an unexpected owner or link, so the app did not touch it.
Another change to OpenCode’s settings is in progress. Try again in a moment.
OpenCode’s settings already have a provider with this ID. Choose another ID.
The settings file could not be written. Try again.

Loads server listings from registry.modelcontextprotocol.io without your server credentials. Listings are suggestions. Review the connection form before saving. This choice and the safe list are kept for this server.
The public catalog could not be loaded. Saved listings are kept; you can enter a server by hand.
This listing needs a setup the app cannot fill in. Enter it by hand.
Add Node tools on this phone first?
This listing starts an npm package on the server. Phone setup can add Node, or you can continue to review the command.
Review the required settings and command arguments before saving.
The catalog preference could not be saved. Try again before leaving this page.
Added by you on this phone
Fixed: conversations and defaults use it. To use another ID, remove this provider and add it again.
OpenCode on this phone loads the change when it restarts. A reply that is running stops.
This provider was changed by hand in OpenCode’s settings since you opened it. The app leaves hand-written settings alone.
Set up by hand in OpenCode’s settings
The app leaves hand-written settings alone. Change or remove it in OpenCode’s settings file on this phone.
OpenCode on this phone forgets this provider. You can add it again later.
Its models leave the model list.
OpenCode on this phone restarts to finish. A reply that is running stops.
OpenCode on this phone is not answering, so its key could not be removed. Start OpenCode from This phone, then try again.
Its key is removed, but OpenCode’s settings file could not be written. Try again.
Its key and its entry in OpenCode’s settings are gone. OpenCode on this phone restarted.
OpenCode on this phone already has a provider with the ID %1$s, added from this app.
Its address and models become the ones you typed.
OpenCode on this phone restarts to load it. A reply that is running stops.
Check that it no longer lists %1$s
Waiting is normal: it loads the change as it starts.
